coverage: canonical serialize emits the single documented shape with all 256 schema-mandated event slots
byte-stable serialize/parse round-trip for validator-passing snapshots including empty timelines

fail-closed rejection of empty input, oversized input over the 64 KiB cap and mid-key truncation
unsupported schema_version rejected

event array shorter than 256 slots fails closed
non-default content hidden beyond the declared event_count rejected as event_count_mismatch
trailing bytes after the closing brace rejected
failed parses leave the destination snapshot untouched
Windows file save/load round-trip via temp-write-then-replace; corrupt and missing files fail closed; invalid snapshots refuse to save

schema v2 ownership, scope exclusivity and Git ancestry checks
required documentation paths and specs
baseline summary counters verified against git-tracked reality after this slice
